sentiment: Old machines end, yet the quiet wish to keep things running softly — without clamor — stays.

stories.title: The End of an Athlon
stories.summary: A machine reaches the end of its road, and someone takes the time to mark the passing — endings are also a kind of record, kept quietly.

stories.title: I Dream of Quieter Computing
stories.summary: A longing for machines that ask less of the room and of us — the wish for softness is not nostalgia, it is a design value still waiting.

stories.title: NetBSD and my life (2005)
stories.summary: A twenty-year-old letter about an operating system braided into a life — some things persist not because they are new, but because they were kept.
